separate_existing_adapters.note: Separate AI Inference service and cost path; it does not pass through the DigitalOcean Control Plane metering client or customer wallet billing.
Current control-plane implementation is read-only and covers only explicitly listed catalog/billing operations; this is not an all-endpoint proxy and not a customer-charge ledger.

ListSessions enumerates sessions for the caller's tenant.
CreateSession provisions a sandbox and starts a Harness Runtime session.
ValidatePolicy checks a manifest's tool-permission policy against the agent's capabilities without creating a session.
ListSandboxSizes returns the customer-selectable sandbox (microVM) size catalog.
DestroySession tears down the sandbox and marks the session DESTROYED.
GetSession returns the current snapshot of a session.
PatchSession updates an existing session (session-scoped settings or live config).
Cancel the agent turn in flight.
ListCheckpoints enumerates a session's checkpoints, newest first.
CreateCheckpoint captures the session's live sandbox state as a durable checkpoint.
DeleteCheckpoint removes a checkpoint and its underlying machine-state capture.
GetCheckpoint returns the current snapshot of a checkpoint.
Read sandbox-image notices for one checkpoint.
RollbackToCheckpoint rewinds a session to a checkpoint.
StreamSessionEvents opens the session's Server-Sent Events feed.
ForkSession creates child sessions from a checkpoint of this session.
ResolveHITL records the user's decision on a pending HITL request.
Read sandbox-image notices for one session.
GetIngressURL returns the public HTTPS URL of the session's OpenHands Agent Server.
SendInput delivers a user chat message into the session.
PauseSession freezes the session's microVM sandbox.
PortForwardSession opens a WebSocket tunnel to a guest TCP port.
ResumeSession explicitly thaws a PAUSED session's microVM sandbox.
ExecInSandbox runs a one-shot command inside the session's sandbox.
Download a file or tar archive from the session's sandbox workspace.
Get the status of a staged workspace transfer.
Mint presigned PUT URLs for one or more multipart upload parts.
Upload a file or tar archive into the session's sandbox workspace.
ListTeamTemplates returns the caller's team custom templates.
CreateTemplate creates a team custom template and kicks a build.
DeleteTemplate deletes a team custom template.
GetTemplate returns a team custom template by public id.
UpdateTemplate updates a team template's source and kicks a new build.
ListTemplateBuilds returns build history for a template.
GetTemplateBuild returns a single template build.
ListTriggers enumerates the calling team's triggers.
CreateTrigger creates a webhook or cron trigger.
GetTriggerBySession reverse-looks-up the trigger that produced or binds a session.
ListReusableSessions lists the team's PAUSED sessions for the reuse picker.
GetTrigger returns a single trigger by id.
UpdateTrigger updates, pauses, or re-enables a trigger.
ListTriggerExecutions returns a trigger's execution history.
GetTriggerExecution returns a single execution, including its payload.
CancelExecution ends a running execution and frees the trigger's in-flight slot.
RotateTriggerSecret issues a new webhook secret.
ReceiveTriggerWebhook accepts a signed delivery from an external system.
ListWebhookProviders lists supported webhook providers for the create-trigger UI.
ListRegions returns the regions the caller's team may create sessions and agent configs in.
